title: Rav Kahana, Father-in-Law of Rav Mesharshiya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 97b, asking Rava. In Ketubot 100b, “Rav Kahana had in his possession the beer of Rav Mesharshiya bar Chilkai, an orphan”; Hyman suggests that possibly this is the same Rav Kahana.[^1]

notes.text: Bava Batra 97b explicitly calls Rav Kahana Rav Mesharshiya’s father-in-law and has him ask Rava. Ketubot 100b mentions Rav Kahana and the orphan Rav Mesharshiya bar Chilkai. Their possible identification is Hyman’s conjecture.
